name: Miyamura Yukari
source: The leader of O.C.S.A.T, the armed special forces formed to counter organized crime. She joins the protagonist Ai in her battle against "Sacrifice", an criminal organization dealing in international human trafficking. She is respected by Ai who thinks of her as the ideal woman.
